verdict.rationale: Snowflake's Secure Data Sharing lets a provider share selected database objects with other Snowflake accounts, and the docs state that no actual data is copied or transferred between accounts. That directly meets the zero-copy, no-export-pipeline core of the story, and data sharing is listed as included in the entry-level Standard tier. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of sharing across separate organizations and with non-Snowflake consumers, explicit documentation that consumers see live updates (only implied by zero-copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
